conclusion: The ledger includes a AUD 50,000.00 receipt dated 30 June 2026 that the bank only credited on 2 July 2026. On this evidence alone the cash balance at 30 June 2026 is overstated by AUD 50,000.00, a cut-off misstatement, unless the remittance is shown to have been banked by 30 June.

reasoning_chain.text: The bank's reply confirms AUD 1,208,400.00 in account 12345601 at 30 June 2026.
The trial balance shows AUD 1,258,400.00 in GL account 1010 at 30 June 2026, AUD 50,000.00 more than the bank.
A receipt of AUD 50,000.00 (CR-SI-2026-0547) was debited to GL account 1010 on 30 June 2026.
The bank credited AUD 50,000.00 with reference SI-2026-0547 to the account on 2 July 2026.
Differences between the confirmation and the records are investigated to see whether they indicate misstatements.
The bank holds no AUD 50,000.00 at 30 June 2026 for the receipt the ledger records on that day.
Without evidence that the funds were in transit at the period end, the ledger overstates cash by AUD 50,000.00, which is a misstatement.
